fixed.explanation: When the sheet holds only the header rows, the parser returns an empty DataFrame with a flat columns Index, as read_csv does. _parse_sheet then calls set_names with two header names on that one-level Index. That raises "Expected 1 name, got 2". The fix applies the names only when the number of column levels equals the number of header names.

input.intent: Excel reader parsing with multi-row header (header=[0,1]) and index_col=0: the code that handles a MultiIndex column header with index_col in read_excel / TextParser (python parser), likely failing when the data has only the index column or empty rows, causing a length mismatch error on names ("Expected 1 name, got 2").
input.symptom: read_excel with header=[0,1] and index_col=0 raises a ValueError (expected 1 name, got 2) while read_csv returns an empty DataFrame.
